pairs_without_data.P2: OHRC <-> NAC: both OHRC observations are over the South Pole (~69.5S, 32.2E, incidence 78-79 deg); no NAC tile from that region is on disk. Part 1 refusal table: report no_data, do not move the target.
pairs_without_data.P3: OHRC <-> TMC-2 ortho: the OHRC products and the TMC-2 strip do not share ground (South Pole vs equatorial swath).
pairs_without_data.P4: IIRS <-> WAC/NAC: no IIRS product was delivered by PRADAN.
pairs_without_data.P6: OHRC in IIRS pixels: depends on P2/P3 and P4, none of which has data.

reasons: Too few verified correspondences: 3 (threshold 8). Near the model's degrees of freedom, a fit can match its own points exactly while being catastrophically wrong.

evidence.name: n_inliers
evidence.statement: Only 3 inliers (rule: reject at <= 8). Validated at recall 1.000 on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002).

evidence.name: loop_error_px
evidence.statement: Not evaluated -- needs a third overlapping image. This is the only estimator shown to catch a coherent wrong solution, so the verdict is weaker than it could be.

evidence.name: coverage_max_gap
evidence.statement: Largest unconstrained region is 0.793 of the image (target <= 0.15). The transform is extrapolating where there are no correspondences.

evidence.name: inlier_ratio
evidence.statement: 3/3 putative matches survived geometric verification. Self-consistency only: misses 8.7% of failures (EXP-002).

evidence.name: fit_rmse
evidence.statement: Reported for transparency and EXCLUDED from the verdict. ROC AUC 0.4947 as a failure detector on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002 objective 3, pre-declared negative control). excluded.fit_rmse: ROC AUC 0.4947 as a failure detector on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002 objective 3, pre-declared negative control). Inverted in the failure regime: EXP-001 measured 10 of 17 catastrophic failures reporting fit RMSE below 1e-12 px while 190-2400 px wrong.
